plan.explanation: Sequence starts with face milling F1 (datum) on M2. Contour milling F5 and chamfering F8 follow on M3 after the datum is established. Spot drilling and drilling operations for blind holes F2, F3, F4, F6, and F7 are performed on M1 after F1. Tool compatibility matches catalogue: face_mill for face_milling, chamfer_mill for contour/chamfering, drill for spot/drilling.
assumptions: Tool T2 is used for both contour_milling and chamfering operations as it is the only chamfer_mill type available in resources.
uncertainties: Exact tool diameter matching to hole diameters (4.0mm, 6.0mm, etc.) is not verified against specific drill sizes in the catalogue; any drill from T1/T4 is assumed compatible.
Tool access for deep blind holes (e.g., F2 depth 16.7mm) is not modelled.
